name: Trophy Display
description: Use ARC parts to build a display of your hunting trophies, in order to not-so-subtly shut down anyone who questions the bold tales of your topside adventures.

phases.name: Roaming Threats
phases.description: The earthbound machines rolling and trudging across the surface, forcing Raiders to watch their every step.

phases.name: Soaring Menaces
phases.description: The airborne machines dominating the skies, raining peril down upon unsuspecting Raiders.

phases.name: Ferocious Foes
phases.description: A clear escalation of topside dangers, these machines have doled out severe punishments to overconfident Raiders.

phases.name: Dominant Dangers
phases.description: The vicious threats leaving behind a trail of downed Raiders; dominating their surroundings with tenacity and grit.

phases.name: Imposing Behemoths
phases.description: The colossal foes making the earth tremble, and the epitome of big-game hunting.

name: Expedition Project (Expedition 1)
description: Expeditions are perilous. Your Raider will carry all their possessions into the unknown beyond the Rust Belt. In return, your next Raider gains a unique edge that lasts until the next Expedition departs.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.description: Building the base structure and frame of the caravan

phases.name: Core Systems
phases.description: Connecting wiring, ventilation, and essential power systems

phases.name: Framework
phases.description: Building walls and roof, installing core systems, and defining the interior layout

phases.name: Outfitting
phases.description: Adding storage, workbenches, utilities, and personal touches

phases.name: Load Stage
phases.description: Loading the caravan with vital supplies. Combat gear, survival equipment, provisions, and repair materials are needed to fully prepare for the Expedition

phases.name: Departure
phases.description:
Your caravan is fully stocked and your Raider is ready to depart on the Expedition!

Upon departure, all items remaining in your Raider’s stash will be contributed to the Expedition, and your next Raider can earn up to five skill points based on the total value of those items.

name: Avian Alarm
description: Speranzans have noticed that some birds are sensitive to atmospheric changes, and have taken to designing multi-tiered alarm systems to warn of impending danger. Though their precision has been debated, the calming effect of their companionship is beyond reproach.

phases.name: Initial Flock Intake
phases.description: Deploy a bird trap next to the Buoys

phases.name: Preliminary Signal Birds
phases.description: Preliminary Signal Birds

phases.name: Secondary Validation Birds
phases.description: Secondary Validation Birds

phases.name: Heightened Alert Birds
phases.description: Heightened Alert Birds

phases.name: Critical Warning Birds
phases.description: Critical Warning Birds

name: Flickering Flames
description: A festival of resilient warmth, centered around the hardy candleberry bush. Speranzans have been known to host local celebrations, and being competitive, they seek to outdo each other at every turn. Some have managed to turn the homely candleberry bush into a banquet worthy of even the most discerning gourmands.

phases.name: Candlelight
phases.description: The namesake use for the candleberry, Speranzans boil the fruit into a thick wax that burns cleanly and fragrantly.

phases.name: Decorations
phases.description: Many Speranzans have become surprisingly adept at the art of bringing beauty and greenery into the home.

phases.name: Presents
phases.description: Crafty Speranzans have turned the candleberries into a wealth of gifts. These include perfumes and soaps, as well as gifts unrelated to the recipient's odors.

phases.name: Beverages
phases.description: Candleberries can be crushed into refreshing juices, while the leaves and roots make for a tea that can drive out the toughest of colds.

phases.name: Meals
phases.description: Though candleberry leaves are bitter, simmering them in stew and soups adds a touch of earthiness that nostalgic Speranzans have grown to love.

name: Weather Monitor System
description: Collect the required parts to build a private weather station, and help monitor the turbulent weather above.

phases.name: Atmospheric pressure
phases.description: Lets you measure if that heavy weight on your shoulders is actually just the air.

phases.name: Sunlight
phases.description: Sunlight might be sparse in Speranza, but ultraviolet rays can still be measured by the right equipment.

phases.name: Precipitation
phases.description: Very few parts of Speranza are completely waterproof. Now you can say it’s for science.

phases.name: Humidity
phases.description: Great for keeping your skin looking luminous, and your walls somewhat moldy.

phases.name: Temperature
phases.description: Significantly more accurate than counting shivers per minute.

name: High-Gain Antenna
description: When placed in open areas, these parabolic dishes can pick up on distant signals within a narrow beamwidth, which may help triangulate the origins of the troubling ARC signals that were recently reported.

phases.name: Sturdy Base
phases.description: An extra-sturdy base that can withstand anything from bitter winds to sudden cloudbursts.

phases.name: Data Logger
phases.description: A closed-circuit interface to monitor and analyze distributed data points over time.

phases.name: Parabolic Dish
phases.description: A custom-built parabolic dish designed to capture distant signals in even the most stormy of conditions.

name: Converging Paths
description: With ARC operations spreading across the Rust Belt, the nomads have agreed to share their knowledge in exchange for support. Raiders are needed to gather supplies, recover relics, and help secure safe passage for nomads traveling through dangerous routes.

phases.name: Secure Safe Passage for the Nomads
phases.description: Deal Damage to ARC enemies in the Swamp

phases.name: Collect Supplies
phases.description: Collect supplies to share with the nomads

phases.name: Procure Relics
phases.description: Find relics to share with the nomads

phases.name: Create Emergency Caches
phases.description: Build emergency caches to help both the nomads and Raiders stay alive on the surface

phases.name: Finish the Cabinet of Curiosities
phases.description: Put the finishing touches on the cabinet of curiosities, a new emblem of blossoming ties between the nomads and Speranza.

phases.name: Use Nomad Tactics to Fight ARC
phases.description: Deal damage to ARC using mines or traps (Blaze Grenade Trap, Pulse Mine, Jolt Mine, Explosive Mine, Surge Coil)

name: Phantom Targets
description: Unrecognizable noise has started flooding Shani's radars, and she can't pinpoint the origin of these phantom targets. Raider assistance is needed to improve antennas on the surface, and track ARC behavior for any changes.

phases.name: Upgrade Cargo Elevator Antennas
phases.description: Upgrade antennas found on top of any Cargo Elevator

phases.name: Test ARC Parts for Irregular Behavior
phases.description: Deal damage to ARC enemies using Wasp Drivers, Pop Triggers and Leaper Pulse Units

phases.name: Test Multiple ARC Destruction Methods
phases.description: Destroy ARC enemies using fire damage, energy damage, and launcher ammo

name: Phantom Targets
description: The phantom targets Shani was tracking have a source: some Wasps are exhibiting patterns we've never seen before. They seem frantic.

phases.name: Bring In Glitched Wasp Parts for Testing
phases.description: Collect glitched Wasp parts

phases.name: Perform Final Tests on Glitched Wasp Parts
phases.description: Collect glitched Wasp parts

phases.name: Conduct One Final Explosive Test
phases.description: Deal damage to any flying ARC using Fireworks
